en.bdb: Sexual urges do not touch the Sikh of the Guru -

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲਖ ਕਾਮਰੂਪ ਲਖ ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh kaaman lakh kaamaroop lakh kaamaniaaree|

en.bdb: Lacs of magician women of lacs of kamaraps (a state in east India where women were supposed to be very beautiful);
The best category of women (Padrnini) of Shilialdvi:p (modern Sri Lanka) adept in embellishments;
Chaste nymphs of Indralok (the abode of Indr, the Vedic god),

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੂਰਾਂ ਪਰੀਆਂ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਹਿਸਤ ਸਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: hooraa(n) pareeaa(n) lakh lakh bahisat savaaree|

en.bdb: Houris of paradise and fairies in lacs;

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਕਉਲਾਂ ਨਵ ਜੋਬਨੀ ਲਖ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: lakh kaulaa(n) nav jobanee lakh kaam karaaree|

en.bdb: Lacs of young girls adept in sexual arts also cannot touch

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਨੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh poh na sakanee saadhasa(n)gat bhaaree ||2||

en.bdb: The gurmukh who resides in the grand holy congregation.
